summary: Verified the map-bell notification panel fix for /karte (mobile). Authenticated path confirmed via source review (NotificationBell testId prop + conditional render matches briefing exactly); guest fallback, layout, tap target and no-console-error/no-4xx criteria verified live in-browser on localhost and the public preview URL. Backend smoke suite (49 tests) and frontend typecheck pass. One pre-existing unrelated check (notification-bell-unread-and-mark-read) fails on a hardcoded German string assertion because the browser's default locale renders English text; the panel itself opens, shows items, marks-read RPC fires, and badge clears correctly — functionality is intact, this is a locale-text mismatch in that older check, not a regression from this fix.

action_items.note: No real Supabase session/credentials available to click-test the authenticated map-bell -> notification-panel flow live. Verified by source: src/routes/karte.tsx renders <NotificationBell testId="map-bell-button" /> when `user` is truthy (same component/Sheet used on profile), and a plain Link to /profil only for guests. This satisfies the acceptance criterion by code path; recommend a quick manual tap-test in a real session before closing out.

Re-ran existing check 'notification-bell-unread-and-mark-read' twice (not flaky, failed both times) on a hardcoded German text assertion ('Möchte mit dir befreundet sein'); screenshot shows the panel rendering the same content in English ('Wants to be your friend'), with Accept/Decline, private-message link, and mark-read-badge-clear logic all working. Unrelated to the map-bell fix (which only adds an optional testId prop and does not touch copy or locale logic). Not filed as a bug against this change; flagging so the check's locale assumption can be revisited separately.
